$comment: Selector map. Each entry is {by, value, name?, exact?, note?, confidence}. 'by' is one of: testid | role | text | label | placeholder | css. Priority order preferred: testid > role+name > href/css. Entries marked confidence:'TODO' MUST be confirmed against the live DOM in Phase 1 before AUDIT_MODE will run — the resolver throws on a TODO selector so nothing silently guesses.

table.note: The pipeline results table (cols: Address, City, State/Province, Created, Status, ...).

rowAddressLink.note: Blue address link in each row.

rowStatusSelect.note: Per-row Status <select>. CONFIRM exact selector; there is also a Publish/Syndicate toggle in the row.

statusFilter.note: The 'Filter By: Status' dropdown near the top; used to filter to New.

statusSelect.note: Resolved in property.js by scanning <select>s for New/Follow up/Under Contract/Closed options (distinguishes it from Deal Type). No manual selector needed.

saveButton.note: property.js clicks a visible Save button if one exists, else relies on the select's change handler; verification is by reload either way.

stateSelect.note: Dropdown offers full names only ('California'); no 'CA'. Never set it (SOP §7A).

attachedContactLink.note: Content-based: the attached contact link on the CONTACTS tab points at /contacts/{id}.

activityItem.note: Empty = use the code fallback in activity.js (heuristic text/time extraction). Fill with a precise selector once the contact-record DOM is confirmed to raise confidence.
